{{Current events header|2015|08|3}}

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
** At least 31 people are dead and dozens injured after a [[Syria]]n fighter jet crashes into a marketplace in the town of [[Ariha, Syria|Ariha]]. [http://www.timescolonist.com/activists-say-a-syrian-warplane-crash-airstrikes-in-northwest-town-kill-and-wound-dozens-1.2019502 (TC via AP)] [http://www.abc.net.au/news/2015-08-03/residents-killed-after-syrian-fighter-jet-crashes-marketplace/6669744 (ABC)] [http://www.ynetnews.com/articles/0,7340,L-4687045,00.html (YNET News)]
;Business and economy
*[[Presidency of Barack Obama|US President Obama]] announced the [[Clean Power Plan]] which includes the first-ever [[Environmental Protection Agency]] standards [[Regulation of greenhouse gases under the Clean Air Act|on carbon pollution]] from U.S. power plants. [https://www.whitehouse.gov/climate-change (White House)][http://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2015/08/03/429044707/president-obama-set-to-unveil-new-power-plant-rules-in-clean-power-plan (NPR)][http://www.theguardian.com/environment/2015/aug/03/obamas-clean-power-plan-hailed-as-strongest-ever-climate-action-by-a-us-president (''The Guardian'')]
*British bank [[HSBC]] agrees to sell its [[Brazil]]ian banking business to [[Banco Bradesco]] for $5.2 billion. [http://www.france24.com/en/20150803-hsbc-profits-fall-38-second-quarter?ns_campaign=reseaux_sociaux&ns_source=twitter&ns_mchannel=social&ns_linkname=editorial&aef_campaign_ref=partage_aef&aef_campaign_date=2015-08-03&dlvrit=66745 (AFP via HSBC)]
*[[Nokia]] sells its mapping application [[Here (Nokia)|Here]] to German car makers [[BMW]], [[Audi]] and [[Mercedes-Benz]] for 2.8 billion [[euro]]s. [http://news.yahoo.com/nokia-selling-mapping-german-car-makers-2-8-071616683.html;_ylt=AwrSbg9YIL9VkQ0Av8RXNyoA;_ylu=X3oDMTByNWU4cGh1BGNvbG8DZ3ExBHBvcwMxBHZ0aWQDBHNlYwNzYw-- (AFP via Yahoo! News)] 
*The [[Athens Stock Exchange]] reopens after more than a month with share values falling by 22 percent in early trading. [http://hosted2.ap.org/APDEFAULT/3d281c11a96b4ad082fe88aa0db04305/Article_2015-08-03-EU--Greece-Bailout/id-6583822e0f264699ace56383a66eacd8 (AP)]
*[[Puerto Rico]] fails to make a scheduled payment of [[United States dollar|US$]]58 million to service its debts of $72 billion.  [[Moody's]] considers the commonwealth in [[default (finance)|default]].  [http://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-us-canada-33769391 (BBC)]
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Flood]]ing caused by heavy [[monsoon]] rains has caused over 100 deaths in [[India]] over the past week with tens of thousands of people taking shelter in [[refugee]] camps. [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-asia-india-33754952 (BBC)]
*Twenty people are injured when two cranes overturn on several houses whilst installing a part of the Julianabrug at [[Alphen aan den Rijn]] in the [[Netherlands]]. [http://www.nltimes.nl/2015/08/03/video-one-victime-rescued-many-hurt-in-crane-collapse/ (NL Times)] [http://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-33762806 (BBC)]
*At least twelve people are killed with many feared trapped in the rubble as a fifty year old building collapses in the [[India]]n city of [[Thane]] after days of heavy rain. [http://www.ndtv.com/cities/6-dead-after-50-year-old-building-collapses-in-thane-1203594 (NDTV)] [http://bigstory.ap.org/article/8bec2e141343456dbb24a883c075849a/building-collapses-near-mumbai-after-heavy-rain-killing-12 (AP)]
;Law and crime
*[[2012 Aurora shooting]]
**In an unanimous decision, the jury ruled that [[James Eagan Holmes]], convicted for the shooting, is still eligible for the [[Capital punishment in the United States|death penalty]]. [http://edition.cnn.com/2015/08/02/us/13th-juror-james-holmes-aurora-shooting/ (CNN International)]
;Sports
*[[2015 World Aquatics Championships]]
**[[Katie Ledecky]] of the [[United States]] breaks her own world record for the {{convert|1500|m|abbr=off}} freestyle clocking 15:27.71 in the final in [[Kazan]], [[Russia]]. [http://www.sportsmole.co.uk/swimming/united-states/result/result-ledecky-makes-history-in-1500m_237001.html (Sportsmole)]
